description: KVClient performance exported by the UCM vLLM connector (default ucm: prefix): request/key throughput, client and transport latency, and errors. Select the intended vLLM scrape job. View switches between model-level aggregation and Engine/Worker series. Node-task histograms pool all node samples within each Worker; individual nodes cannot be selected. Durations are in seconds. Model and Worker selectors use the same UCM metric discovery as the Connector dashboard; selecting a model does not imply that KVClient metrics are available.

panels.description: Total KV client asynchronous API submission rate. With Worker set to All, aggregation includes scheduler submissions when scheduler KV series are present, as well as the selected worker submissions. These are KV operation submissions, not unique inference requests.

panels.title: Error Rate by Stage
panels.description: Error ratios by operation: Store/Load/BatchStore/BatchLoad/Query/Delete report submission errors divided by submission requests; Wait reports final-result errors divided by Wait requests. Ratios use aggregated counter rates across the selected workers. These are separate operation ratios; do not add them to obtain an overall error rate. The denominator is clamped to 1e-12 to avoid division by zero. Existing series with zero errors and zero requests in the window display zero; this does not mean requests were observed. Missing series remain absent.
